sources.excerpt: Published on September 21, 2025 Couch Electronics overdrive pedal Information The Couch Electronics Blue Whale is a boutique low gain overdrive pedal built in Slovenia, inspired by the classic Bluesbreaker-style circuit. It delivers increased volume, brightness, and a subtle midrange presence compared to the original design, providing a lively and articulate response that remains touch-sensitive under the fingers. Designed to enhance harmonic content without overwhelming the guitar's natural character, the Blue Whale offers more gain on tap than traditional Bluesbreaker pedals while retaining clarity and dynamic control. The pedal is housed in a compact, durable enclosure finished in a deep metallic blue with a purple LED indicator. It uses a true bypass relay circuit with optical switching, ensuring silent and reliable operation. An internal power-up state switch allows the user to set whether the pedal defaults to ON or OFF when power is applied, with the factory default set to OFF. Built for pedalboard convenience, the Blue Whale combines a straightforward control layout with thoughtful engineering to provide consistent performance in a small format.
